Weaves

Length, volume and movement that blend like your own hair. Installed with care, styled with intention and finished for a natural, confident look that lasts.

Something Worth Asking

Ever loved a style in the chair, then watched it stop looking like the picture two weeks later?

It happens more than it should. The style was right. Something underneath it was not, and that is the part nobody talks about before you book.

Here Is The Difference

A great first day is easy.
A great third week is craft.

What decides how your hair holds up is rarely the style itself. It is the install that sits right, the fit that was measured to you, the tension that protects your hair instead of pulling at it, and a stylist who listened before she started. That is where styles are won or lost, and it is exactly where Amirror has spent 12 years.

Installed to last
Fitted to you
Your hair protected

Meet The Studio

12 years. One standard.

Amirror Hair Studio has spent 12 years serving East Charlotte with a single focus: Black hair, done with skill and respect.

Every appointment starts with listening. What you want. How you live. How you wear your hair every day. Then the work begins, with no rushing and no guessing.

The name says it. The best moment in the studio is the mirror moment, when you see the finished look and it is exactly what you pictured. That moment is the whole point, and it has been the point for 12 years.
